hook.en: A road can be unbroken yet have a sharp corner. At the corner the road is continuous, but the direction suddenly changes. That is the difference between continuous and differentiable.
hook.kn: ರಸ್ತೆ ತುಂಡಾಗದಿದ್ದರೂ ಚೂಪಾದ ತಿರುವು ಇರಬಹುದು. ತಿರುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರಸ್ತೆ ಸಂತತ, ಆದರೆ ದಿಕ್ಕು ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದೇ ಸಂತತತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅವಕಲನೀಯತೆಯ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ.

narration.en: A road can be unbroken yet have a sharp corner. At the corner the road is continuous, but the direction suddenly changes. That is the difference between continuous and differentiable.
narration.kn: ರಸ್ತೆ ತುಂಡಾಗದಿದ್ದರೂ ಚೂಪಾದ ತಿರುವು ಇರಬಹುದು. ತಿರುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರಸ್ತೆ ಸಂತತ, ಆದರೆ ದಿಕ್ಕು ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದೇ ಸಂತತತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅವಕಲನೀಯತೆಯ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ.

body.en: $f$ is differentiable at $c$ if $f'(c) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{f(c + h) - f(c)}{h}$ exists, i.e. the left-hand and right-hand derivatives are equal. Every differentiable function is continuous, but $|x|$ is continuous at 0 and not differentiable there (LHD = −1, RHD = 1).
body.kn: ಎಡ ಮತ್ತು ಬಲ ಅವಕಲಜಗಳು ಸಮವಾದರೆ f, c ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಕಲನೀಯ. ಅವಕಲನೀಯ ಫಲನ ಸಂತತ; ಆದರೆ |x|, 0 ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತತ, ಅವಕಲನೀಯವಲ್ಲ.

points.en: |x − a| has a corner at x = a

narration.en: A function is differentiable at c if the derivative from the left equals the derivative from the right. Differentiable functions are continuous, but a corner, like mod x at zero, is continuous without being differentiable.
narration.kn: ಎಡ ಮತ್ತು ಬಲ ಅವಕಲಜಗಳು ಸಮವಾದರೆ f, c ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಕಲನೀಯ. ಅವಕಲನೀಯ ಫಲನ ಸಂತತ; ಆದರೆ |x|, 0 ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತತ, ಅವಕಲನೀಯವಲ್ಲ.

say.en: mod x is continuous at zero but has a sharp corner. The slope from the left is minus 1 and from the right is plus 1.
The derivative exists only when this limit gives the same value from both sides.
Chain rule: differentiate the outer function, keep the inside, then multiply by the derivative of the inside.
Another: 3 x plus 1 to the power 5. Bring down the 5, lower the power, times 3.

narration.en: On the board: Corners and chains.

body.en: If $y = f(t)$ and $t = g(x)$, then $\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{dt} \cdot \frac{dt}{dx}$. Differentiate the outer function, keep the inside, then multiply by the derivative of the inside.
body.kn: y = f(t), t = g(x) ಆದರೆ dy/dx = dy/dt × dt/dx. ಹೊರಗಿನ ಫಲನವನ್ನು ಅವಕಲಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ ಒಳಗಿನದರ ಅವಕಲಜದಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿ.

narration.en: By the chain rule, d y by d x equals d y by d t times d t by d x. Differentiate the outside, keep the inside, and multiply by the derivative of the inside.
narration.kn: y = f(t), t = g(x) ಆದರೆ dy/dx = dy/dt × dt/dx. ಹೊರಗಿನ ಫಲನವನ್ನು ಅವಕಲಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ ಒಳಗಿನದರ ಅವಕಲಜದಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿ.

caption.en: A smooth curve like y = x² has a definite tangent at every point: it is differentiable everywhere.

tryThis.en: Zoom in at any point: the curve looks more and more like a straight line.
Compare with |x| at 0, which stays a sharp corner however far you zoom.

narration.en: A smooth curve like y equals x squared has a tangent at every point. Zoom in anywhere and it looks like a straight line. That is what differentiable means.

caption.en: y = x² (yellow). The green secant joins x = 1 and x = 1 + h; the white line is the tangent at x = 1.

tryThis.en: Take h = 0.1 and h = −0.1. Do both sides approach 2?
Try the same idea for |x| at 0 in your notebook: what goes wrong?

narration.en: Shrink h towards zero from either side. The secant slope, 2 plus h, closes in on the tangent slope 2.

steps.en: Outer: sin u, derivative cos u. Inner: u = x², derivative 2x.

body.en: Differentiable means "locally straight". If zooming in on a graph at a point still shows a corner or a cusp, the function is not differentiable there.

narration.en: Recap. Differentiable at c: LHD = RHD. Differentiable ⇒ continuous; the converse fails at corners. Chain rule: dy/dx = dy/dt · dt/dx.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. c ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಕಲನೀಯ: ಎಡ ಅವಕಲಜ = ಬಲ ಅವಕಲಜ. ಅವಕಲನೀಯ ⇒ ಸಂತತ; ವಿಲೋಮ ಮೂಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಪ್ಪು. ಸರಪಳಿ ನಿಯಮ: dy/dx = dy/dt · dt/dx.
